# Prototype Kit (web)

> A brand-agnostic Next.js prototype kit (App Router, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui) for dashboards, marketing pages and
> AI product interfaces. Pages are composed ONLY from the components listed below; nothing else exists.

Generated by `npm run registry:build` from registry/components.ts — do not edit by hand.

## Read first

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): stack, commands, how to build a prototype, gotchas
- [DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](DESIGN_SYSTEM.md): tokens, the component registry, patterns, anti-patterns, the hallucination guard
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): the design tokens in the DESIGN.md format

## Rules

- Use only the components below, by their exact names. Missing something: stop and say so (the `add-component` skill adds it properly).
- Style with semantic Tailwind classes only. No hex, no Tailwind palette colours, no inline colour styles.
- Icons from lucide-react. Charts take colours from `var(--chart-1)`…`--chart-5`.
- Check every page in light and dark, at 375px and 1280px wide.

## Components

### Actions

- [Button / `buttonVariants`](components/ui/button.tsx): `variant` default/secondary/outline/ghost/link/destructive · `size` default/sm/lg/icon · `asChild` for links — `<Button variant? size? asChild?>Label</Button>`
- [Toggle / `toggleVariants`](components/ui/toggle.tsx): a pressed/unpressed button (bold, mute, favourite) — `<Toggle pressed onPressedChange aria-label>…</Toggle>`
- [ToggleGroup / ToggleGroupItem](components/ui/toggle-group.tsx): `type` single (a segmented control) or multiple — `<ToggleGroup type="single" value onValueChange><ToggleGroupItem value>…</ToggleGroupItem></ToggleGroup>`

### Inputs & selection

- [Input](components/ui/input.tsx): always with a `Label` · `aria-invalid` for errors — `<Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label><Input id="email" type="email" />`
- [Label](components/ui/label.tsx): `htmlFor` the field it names
- [Textarea](components/ui/textarea.tsx): multi-line text, grows with content — `<Textarea id placeholder rows? />`
- [Checkbox](components/ui/checkbox.tsx): `checked onCheckedChange` · pick any — `<Checkbox id checked onCheckedChange /><Label htmlFor>…</Label>`
- [RadioGroup / RadioGroupItem](components/ui/radio-group.tsx): pick exactly one · `RadioGroupItem value id` — `<RadioGroup value onValueChange><RadioGroupItem value id /></RadioGroup>`
- [Switch](components/ui/switch.tsx): a setting that applies at once (no Save button) — `<Switch id checked onCheckedChange />`
- [Select / SelectTrigger / SelectValue / SelectContent / SelectItem](components/ui/select.tsx): one of 5–15 options in a form; fewer → RadioGroup, more → Command — `<Select value onValueChange><SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent><SelectItem value /></SelectContent></Select>`
- [DatePicker](components/kit/date-picker.tsx): one date in a form · field-styled button → Calendar in a Popover · `value onChange disabled?` — `<DatePicker id value onChange placeholder? disabled? />`
- [Calendar / CalendarDayButton](components/ui/calendar.tsx): a month grid (react-day-picker) · `mode` single/range/multiple · use DatePicker for a form field — `<Calendar mode="single" selected onSelect disabled? />`
- [Slider](components/ui/slider.tsx): a value on a range · two thumbs for a range — `<Slider value onValueChange min max step aria-label />`

### Navigation

- [AppShell](components/kit/app-shell.tsx): sidebar of 4–8 destinations on desktop, a sheet on mobile · active item follows the URL — `<AppShell brand nav={[{href,label,icon}]} footer? topbar?>{page}</AppShell>`
- [Tabs / TabsList / TabsTrigger / TabsContent](components/ui/tabs.tsx): switch views of the same thing in place; not page navigation — `<Tabs defaultValue><TabsList><TabsTrigger value /></TabsList><TabsContent value /></Tabs>`
- [NavigationMenu / NavigationMenuList / NavigationMenuItem / NavigationMenuTrigger / NavigationMenuContent / NavigationMenuLink / `navigationMenuTriggerStyle`](components/ui/navigation-menu.tsx): a marketing site’s top nav with dropdown panels · not for app navigation (AppShell) — `<NavigationMenu><NavigationMenuList><NavigationMenuItem><NavigationMenuTrigger /><NavigationMenuContent /></NavigationMenuItem></NavigationMenuList></NavigationMenu>`
- [Breadcrumb / BreadcrumbList / BreadcrumbItem / BreadcrumbLink / BreadcrumbPage / BreadcrumbSeparator](components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx): where a detail page sits · the last item is the current page — `<Breadcrumb><BreadcrumbList><BreadcrumbItem><BreadcrumbLink href /></BreadcrumbItem>…</BreadcrumbList></Breadcrumb>`
- [Pagination / PaginationContent / PaginationItem / PaginationLink / PaginationPrevious / PaginationNext / PaginationEllipsis](components/ui/pagination.tsx): pages of a long list or table · Previous/Next + page links · `isActive` on the current page — `<Pagination><PaginationContent><PaginationItem><PaginationPrevious href /></PaginationItem>…</PaginationContent></Pagination>`
- [Command / CommandDialog / CommandInput / CommandList / CommandEmpty / CommandGroup / CommandItem](components/ui/command.tsx): search-as-you-type list · `CommandDialog` for a ⌘K palette — `<Command><CommandInput /><CommandList><CommandGroup heading><CommandItem /></CommandGroup></CommandList></Command>`

### Data display

- [DataTable](components/kit/data-table.tsx): sortable columns + built-in empty state · `columns rows rowKey caption?` — `<DataTable columns={[{key,header,cell?,sortValue?,align?}]} rows rowKey caption? />`
- [Table / TableHeader / TableBody / TableRow / TableHead / TableCell / TableCaption](components/ui/table.tsx): the primitive under DataTable; use it directly for small static tables
- [StatTile](components/kit/stat-tile.tsx): one KPI with a signed change · `invert` when down is good — `<StatTile label value delta? deltaLabel? invert? />`
- [ChartContainer / ChartTooltip / ChartTooltipContent / ChartLegend / ChartLegendContent](components/ui/chart.tsx): Recharts with the theme · series colours from `var(--chart-1)`…`--chart-5` — `<ChartContainer config={{ key: { label, color: "var(--chart-1)" } }}><BarChart data>…</BarChart></ChartContainer>`
- [Badge / `badgeVariants`](components/ui/badge.tsx): a status or tag · a status is an outline Badge with a coloured dot (`bg-success` …), the word in foreground text — `<Badge variant?>Label</Badge>`
- [Avatar / AvatarImage / AvatarFallback](components/ui/avatar.tsx): image with initials fallback — `<Avatar><AvatarImage src alt /><AvatarFallback>AM</AvatarFallback></Avatar>`
- [Separator](components/ui/separator.tsx): a hairline between groups · prefer spacing

### Feedback & status

- [Alert / AlertTitle / AlertDescription](components/ui/alert.tsx): inline and persistent · `variant` default/destructive — `<Alert variant?><Icon /><AlertTitle /><AlertDescription /></Alert>`
- [Toaster](components/ui/sonner.tsx): transient confirmation · `toast()` from `sonner` · the Toaster is in the root layout — `import { toast } from 'sonner'; toast.success('Saved')`
- [Progress](components/ui/progress.tsx): determinate 0–100 — `<Progress value aria-label />`
- [Skeleton](components/ui/skeleton.tsx): the shape of content that is loading — `<Skeleton className="h-4 w-48" />`
- [EmptyState](components/kit/empty-state.tsx): nothing here yet, and the way out · `default` page / `compact` in a card — `<EmptyState icon title description? action? variant? />`

### Containers & layout

- [PageHeader](components/kit/page-header.tsx): title, description and actions · one per page, first in the content — `<PageHeader eyebrow? title description? actions? />`
- [Card / CardHeader / CardTitle / CardDescription / CardAction / CardContent / CardFooter](components/ui/card.tsx): a raised surface for one group · never nest cards — `<Card><CardHeader><CardTitle /><CardDescription /></CardHeader><CardContent /></Card>`
- [Accordion / AccordionItem / AccordionTrigger / AccordionContent](components/ui/accordion.tsx): FAQs and long optional detail
- [Collapsible / CollapsibleTrigger / CollapsibleContent](components/ui/collapsible.tsx): one show/hide region
- [ScrollArea / ScrollBar](components/ui/scroll-area.tsx): a fixed-height region that scrolls on its own

### Overlays

- [Dialog / DialogTrigger / DialogContent / DialogHeader / DialogTitle / DialogDescription / DialogFooter / DialogClose](components/ui/dialog.tsx): a short task on top of the page (an edit form) — `<Dialog><DialogTrigger asChild /><DialogContent><DialogHeader><DialogTitle /></DialogHeader>…</DialogContent></Dialog>`
- [AlertDialog / AlertDialogTrigger / AlertDialogContent / AlertDialogAction / AlertDialogCancel](components/ui/alert-dialog.tsx): confirm something destructive · name the action on the button
- [Sheet / SheetTrigger / SheetContent / SheetHeader / SheetTitle / SheetDescription / SheetFooter](components/ui/sheet.tsx): a side panel: filters, a record’s details, mobile navigation · `side`
- [Drawer / DrawerTrigger / DrawerContent / DrawerHeader / DrawerTitle / DrawerDescription / DrawerFooter / DrawerClose](components/ui/drawer.tsx): a bottom sheet you can drag down (vaul) · mobile-first quick actions and filters — `<Drawer><DrawerTrigger asChild /><DrawerContent><DrawerHeader><DrawerTitle /></DrawerHeader>…<DrawerFooter /></DrawerContent></Drawer>`
- [Popover / PopoverTrigger / PopoverContent](components/ui/popover.tsx): a small panel anchored to a control
- [DropdownMenu / DropdownMenuTrigger / DropdownMenuContent / DropdownMenuItem / DropdownMenuLabel / DropdownMenuSeparator](components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx): actions on a thing (row menu, account menu) · `variant="destructive"` items last
- [Tooltip / TooltipTrigger / TooltipContent](components/ui/tooltip.tsx): names an icon button · never the only place information lives

### Marketing

- [Hero](components/kit/hero.tsx): one promise, one primary action · `media` for a product shot, omit for centred — `<Hero eyebrow? title description? actions? media? />`
- [FeatureGrid](components/kit/feature-grid.tsx): 3–6 short blocks · `columns` 2/3 — `<FeatureGrid features={[{icon,title,description}]} columns? />`
- [PricingCard](components/kit/pricing-card.tsx): one plan · 2–4 side by side · `highlighted` on one — `<PricingCard name price period? description? features action highlighted? />`

### AI product

- [ChatMessage](components/kit/chat-message.tsx): one turn · user = bubble on the right, assistant = plain text on the left — `<ChatMessage role="user|assistant" initials?>{content}</ChatMessage>`
- [ChatComposer](components/kit/chat-composer.tsx): Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks · `busy` turns Send into Stop · `accept` turns on attachments (paperclip, drop, chips) — `<ChatComposer onSend={(text, files) => …} busy? onStop? placeholder? accept? maxFiles? />`
- [AttachmentChip / `formatBytes`](components/kit/attachment-chip.tsx): a file in a conversation: icon by type, name, size · `onRemove` while composing — `<AttachmentChip file={{ name, size, type? }} onRemove? />`
- [ChatThreadList](components/kit/chat-thread-list.tsx): past conversations, grouped by when · `threads activeId onSelect onNew?` — `<ChatThreadList threads={[{id,title,preview?,group?}]} activeId onSelect onNew? />`
- [SourceList / CitedText / `stripCitations`](components/kit/sources.tsx): what an answer is based on · numbered chips with previews · `[n]` in text → inline citations — `<CitedText text="… [1]" sources={[{ title, meta?, snippet?, href? }]} /><SourceList sources />`
- [FollowUpSuggestions](components/kit/follow-up-suggestions.tsx): next questions under the latest answer · picking one sends it — `<FollowUpSuggestions suggestions={["…"]} onSelect />`
- [StreamingText / `useStreamingText`](components/kit/streaming-text.tsx): an answer arriving · all at once under reduced motion · screen readers get it once — `<StreamingText text onDone? />`
- [ThinkingIndicator](components/kit/thinking-indicator.tsx): the model is working · say what it is doing when you can — `<ThinkingIndicator label? />`
- [ToolCallCard](components/kit/tool-call-card.tsx): an action the assistant took · `status` running/done/error/stopped · details collapsed — `<ToolCallCard title status input? output? />`
- [ApprovalCard](components/kit/approval-card.tsx): consent before consequence · says what changes and whether it can be undone — `<ApprovalCard title description? details? onApprove onDeny />`

## Tokens

Colours are semantic names only, used as Tailwind classes (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`,
`border-border`, `bg-success/15`). Never hex, never Tailwind palette colours. Both themes are
required; every fill/foreground pairing clears WCAG AA (4.5:1), enforced by `npm run tokens:build`.
A tone's own text on its own tint (`text-success` on `bg-success/15`) clears AA only for these
tints; on a stronger one, put `text-foreground` on the tint:
primary up to /5, success up to /5, warning up to /5, info up to /15, destructive never.

| Name | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| `background` | #ffffff | #09090b |
| `foreground` | #09090b | #fafafa |
| `card` | #ffffff | #18181b |
| `card-foreground` | #09090b | #fafafa |
| `popover` | #ffffff | #18181b |
| `popover-foreground` | #09090b | #fafafa |
| `primary` | #2563eb | #3b82f6 |
| `primary-foreground` | #ffffff | #09090b |
| `secondary` | #f4f4f5 | #27272a |
| `secondary-foreground` | #18181b | #fafafa |
| `muted` | #f4f4f5 | #27272a |
| `muted-foreground` | #52525b | #a1a1aa |
| `accent` | #f4f4f5 | #27272a |
| `accent-foreground` | #18181b | #fafafa |
| `destructive` | #dc2626 | #ef4444 |
| `destructive-foreground` | #ffffff | #09090b |
| `success` | #15803d | #22c55e |
| `success-foreground` | #ffffff | #09090b |
| `warning` | #b45309 | #fbbf24 |
| `warning-foreground` | #ffffff | #09090b |
| `info` | #0369a1 | #0ea5e9 |
| `info-foreground` | #ffffff | #09090b |
| `border` | #e4e4e7 | #27272a |
| `input` | #e4e4e7 | #27272a |
| `ring` | #2563eb | #3b82f6 |
| `sidebar` | #fafafa | #18181b |
| `sidebar-foreground` | #09090b | #fafafa |
| `sidebar-primary` | #2563eb | #3b82f6 |
| `sidebar-primary-foreground` | #ffffff | #09090b |
| `sidebar-accent` | #f4f4f5 | #27272a |
| `sidebar-accent-foreground` | #18181b | #fafafa |
| `sidebar-border` | #e4e4e7 | #27272a |
| `sidebar-ring` | #2563eb | #3b82f6 |
| `chart-1` | #3b82f6 | #60a5fa |

| `chart-3` | #f59e0b | #fbbf24 |
| `chart-4` | #ef4444 | #f87171 |
| `chart-5` | #0ea5e9 | #38bdf8 |

- Spacing (4-pt grid, Tailwind numeric scale): 0 0px · 1 4px · 2 8px · 3 12px · 4 16px · 5 20px · 6 24px · 8 32px · 10 40px · 12 48px · 16 64px
- Radius (`rounded-*`): sm 6px · md 8px · lg 10px · xl 16px · 2xl 20px · full 9999px; base `--radius` = 10px
- Font sizes (`text-*`): xs 12px · sm 14px · base 16px · lg 18px · xl 20px · 2xl 24px · 3xl 30px · 4xl 36px
- Durations: fast 150ms · base 200ms · slow 300ms
